title: Sharp kinetic trace theory
summary: We establish sharp kinetic trace estimates and counterexamples across several velocity models. For half-space position domains, without any common bound on velocity support, we prove the natural trace estimate for both Lebesgue and standard Gaussian velocity measures. Density yields natural trace operators and Green's formula on the corresponding kinetic energy spaces.
